comment: Name entry cursor grids (structure): per table the release groups (`regions`: the releases that share the bytes, empty = all four), the number of 8-byte rows and the ROM address per release. The cell values are extracted from the ROM (assets/menu/name_input.txt). Format: docs/formats/menu-data.md
header: # Name entry screen: cursor grids (selected by strcMenuData.tableSelector 0 / 1 / 2; read by fMenu_LoadNameInputCursorPos and fMenu_GetNameInputCellField).
# One row per cell (8 bytes, row number = strcMenuData.menuIdx): x y down up right left char action
#   x, y     cursor position on screen (pixels)
#   down/up/right/left   index of the neighbouring cell for the D-pad (fNameInput_*Button)
#   char     glyph index of the letter the cell enters (A button); 00 in the character set switch cells
#   action   00 = enter the letter `char`; 01-04 = switch to character set 0-3 (fNameInput_SelectCharTable0-3)
# `table <label> [releases]`: a table that only some releases use lists them (US EU DE JP); the one with US is the default.
